items.text: Advertising careers cover creative, strategy, account management, media planning, production and digital roles, and they reward original ideas, clear thinking and the ability to work under tight deadlines with clients, with portfolio proof counting more than the degree.
Pick a role family, build a portfolio of campaign ideas with rationale and apply to agencies and brands with samples.
Ask about workload, creative credit and client mix before accepting a role.
